text:
Which statement about elements in Group I of the Periodic Table is correct?
A
Rubidium has a greater density than caesium.
B
Lithium has a higher melting point than potassium.
C
Potassium is more reactive than rubidium.
D
Rubidium atoms have more outer shell electrons than sodium atoms.

options.label: A
options.text: Rubidium has a greater density than caesium.

options.label: B
options.text: Lithium has a higher melting point than potassium.

options.label: C
options.text: Potassium is more reactive than rubidium.

options.label: D
options.text: Rubidium atoms have more outer shell electrons than sodium atoms.
